# Reference title emphasis

<a id="_preface"></a>
## Preface

Default: [Chapter **bold**](#chapter); [Unnumbered chapter](#plain); [Appendix](#appendix).

Basic: [*Chapter **bold***](#chapter); [*Unnumbered chapter*](#plain); [*Appendix*](#appendix).

Short: [Chapter 1](#chapter); [*Unnumbered chapter*](#plain); [Appendix A](#appendix).

Full: [Chapter 1, *Chapter **bold***](#chapter); [*Unnumbered chapter*](#plain); [Appendix A, *Appendix*](#appendix).

Fallback: [*Chapter **bold***](#chapter); [*Chapter **bold***](#chapter).

Explicit: [Custom **label**](#chapter); [Reference **label**](#labelled).

Document basic: [*Chapter **bold***](#chapter); [*Unnumbered chapter*](#plain); [*Appendix*](#appendix); [Ordinary section](#section); [Reference **label**](#labelled).

Document note.[^1]

Script: <sup>[*Chapter **bold***](#chapter)</sup>.
